description: The HTTP/1.1 server from yt/yt/core/http, YTsaurus's own C++ networking library, on its thread-pool poller with one thread per core. This is the exact server every YTsaurus master, proxy, scheduler and node runs its monitoring/API endpoints on in production. Routing is method-agnostic path matching (exact or trailing-slash prefix, no named path parameters), the request body is drained with the async zero-copy input stream, and the response is built by mutating a writer (SetStatus + header map + WriteBody) rather than declared in one call.
